package service

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
)

// scenario for service_method_handles_request_binding_or_header_extraction: Services that extract headers, cookies, forms, or route params directly.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type AuditService struct {
	repo AuditRepository
}

func (s *AuditService) LogEvent(r *http.Request) error {
	tenantID := r.Header.Get("X-Tenant-ID")
	if tenantID == "" {
		return errors.New("missing tenant id header")
	}
	userAgent := r.Header.Get("User-Agent")
	correlationID := r.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID")

	var body map[string]interface{}
	if r.Body != nil {
		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&body); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return s.repo.Insert(context.Background(), tenantID, userAgent, correlationID, body)
}

type AuditRepository interface {
	Insert(ctx context.Context, tenantID, userAgent, correlationID string, body map[string]interface{}) error
}
